context_diary: The account lookup system provides comprehensive profile data including type classification (USER, AGENT, ADMIN, CURRENCY_AGENT). Hierarchy traversal works bidirectionally with ancestors/descendants options, returning structured chain data. Agent accounts have upward hierarchies leading to currency agents and ultimately platform admins. The system maintains email, ID, and type metadata at each hierarchy level. Currency-specific agent structures exist (e.g., GBP currency agents) that sit between regular agents and top-level admins. This pattern suggests multi-tier agent management with currency-based grouping.
